record: An Grianán Theatre’s anniversary building history
facts: The theatre first opened to the public on 4 October 1999. The glass-fronted façade remains a defining feature.
The stage is 17 metres wide and 10.7 metres deep to the tab line. The stage grid is 13.2 metres high.
The Town Clock was installed in 2014 during renovations to the front of the building.
